# Mask3DExtension

<!-- gen:begin summary -->
<!-- Generated by `npm run generate:op-docs` from noodles-validate/registry.json. The title and the text between gen:begin and gen:end markers are replaced on every run; write anywhere else. -->

Show only a sphere around a lng/lat/alt (meters) of a Tile3DLayer, fading to white at the edge.
<!-- gen:end summary -->

## Syntax

<!-- gen:begin syntax -->
```json
{
  "id": "/mask3d-extension",
  "type": "Mask3DExtensionOp",
  "position": { "x": 0, "y": 0 },
  "data": { "inputs": {} }
}
```

Expressions and code read its fields as `op('/mask3d-extension').par.targetPosition` (an input) and `op('/mask3d-extension').out.extension` (an output). Edges name the same fields as handles: `par.targetPosition`, `out.extension`.
<!-- gen:end syntax -->

## Inputs

<!-- gen:begin inputs -->
| Name | Type | Default |
|------|------|---------|
| `targetPosition` | `Point3DField` | `[-118.2637,34.0171,0]` |
| `innerRadius` | `NumberField` | `1000` |
| `fadeRange` | `NumberField` | `7` |
<!-- gen:end inputs -->

## Outputs

<!-- gen:begin outputs -->
| Name | Type |
|------|------|
| `extension` | `ExtensionField` |
<!-- gen:end outputs -->
